summary: Goldfield & Banks is a Sydney-headquartered luxury fragrance house founded in 2016, selling through distributors and department stores across dozens of countries. In September-October 2026 it launched in Kenya via Space X Maven, held Dubai events with Luxe House UAE and Revalue, and unveiled a perfume at Printemps Haussmann in Paris through distributor Differentes Latitudes. Finance Manager Paul Sander, an ex-Deloitte auditor in the role since December 2024, runs a very small finance function.

hooks.text: Rapid 2026 market openings (Kenya, Dubai, Paris) all run through distributors, so remittances, currencies and short-pays land on a one-person finance function.
Paul's audit background (Deloitte France) suggests he values a clean, traceable trail over opaque AI.
Planned regional ecommerce adds payment-platform payouts to reconcile.

risks.text: Founder said in 2025 the company may raise capital; ownership or finance process could change.
Country and revenue figures vary between sources (52, 70, 80 countries), so no figures are used in drafts beyond what is cited.

gaps: No Paul Sander posts, podcasts or interviews found.
No finance job ad or confirmed accounting stack (Xero/NetSuite etc.).
Finance headcount of 1 comes from Attio, not a public source.
